Rae (Marketing): Need a concise run-of-show and fallback rubric for this Fri's webinar: topic 'Serving LLMs reliably at scale'. Can we finalize speakers + rehearsal windows?
Ian (Events): I can do 30m session. Suggested: Lina intro (2m), live demo (12m), benchmark talk (8m), Q&A (8m). Rehearsal Thursday 3pm PT?
Lina (Content): I have 2 headline variants and a short abstract. Posting now.
Omar (Demand): We're targeting infra engineers; include a gated benchmark PDF on TY page and short survey.
Rae (Marketing): Draft abstract: 'Operational strategies for predictable LLM inference: batching, caching, and graceful degradation.' Lina, drop your 2 headlines.
Lina (Content): Headline 1: 'Minimize latency, maximize predictability: LLM serving patterns.' Headline 2: 'Practical runbooks to avoid inference surprises.'
Ian (Events): Rehearsal Thu 3pm PT OK. I'll create backstage doc and test video fallback. dev-bot: 'Created rehearsal event.'
Omar (Demand): Lead routing plan: immediate -> demo interest tag, secondary -> nurture with benchmark PDF. I'll prepare the PDF.
Rae (Marketing): Demo fallback: Plan A live API, Plan B recorded + Plan C screenshots. Can someone make a 60s condensed clip?
Lina (Content): I'll produce the clip. Also prepping registration blurbs.
Ian (Events): Run-of-show refined: 00:00-00:30 housekeeping; 00:30-02:30 abstract; 02:30-14:30 demo; 14:30-22:30 benchmarks; 22:30-30:00 Q&A/CTA. Add 30s handoff after demo.
Rae (Marketing): Add poll during Q&A: 'Biggest serving pain?' options. Omar will own.
Omar (Demand): Confirm. Also recommend we capture poll emails for SDRs.
Lina (Content): Action items: I'll post copy by EOD. Omar  benchmark PDF. Ian  rehearsal invite & backstage doc. Rae  landing page. dev-bot: 'Reminder set: Post assets by EOD'
Rae (Marketing): Great. Closing - we'll run 15m dry-run before rehearsal. Thanks!
